task.title: Preserve workflow-phase diagnoses as linked task evidence
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/763 with a phase-assisted diagnostic turn that records model analysis against one exact caller-selected Attempt.
acceptance_criteria: Validate active association, fresh Diagnostic ID, exact parent Attempt, writable session, and phase bindings before provider effects.
Atomically persist valid assistant content with a matching parented Diagnostic.
Preserve only the human turn on provider failure or blank content and reject racing evidence without an orphan assistant turn.
Do not classify the response as Verification, terminal intent, or workflow lifecycle authority.

attempts.diagnostic: Focused workflow-phase diagnostic tests failed because execute_workflow_phase_task_diagnostic_turn did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added selected-skill, exact-lineage, invalid-preflight, provider-failure, durability, and race tests.

attempts.diagnostic: The shared phase preflight and generic atomic assistant/evidence transaction could preserve analysis without creating a new Attempt.
attempts.patch: Added the diagnostic runtime method, parented Diagnostic append helper, focused errors, ADR, and behavior documentation.

attempts.summary: Corrected the documented non-goal boundary after review.
attempts.diagnostic: Substantive review found that broad statements excluding runtime diagnostics contradicted the new explicit parented workflow-phase Diagnostic operation.
attempts.patch: Narrowed both non-goals to exclude only unrelated runtime diagnostics, reran verification, and held merge until the documentation fix received exact-head review capacity.

outcome.summary: A selected phase can preserve model-produced Diagnostic evidence linked to one Attempt without turning that analysis into independent Verification, terminal truth, or workflow authority.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test workflow_phase_runtime diagnostic

lessons: A diagnosis can be useful linked evidence without proving that its explanation is correct.
Provider-produced Diagnostic and independently observed Verification need different authority contracts.
Substantive review found that the broad runtime-diagnostic non-goal contradicted the new parented Diagnostic operation; the fix narrowed both non-goals to exclude only unrelated diagnostics.
Incremental fixes require substantive exact-head review after any rate-limit cooldown.
